mission_06: Well done! You have successfully created meaningful interaction features from raw data. You learned how to compute BMI as a ratio of weight to height squared, create multiplicative interactions between age and exercise, and derive a per-year exercise rate. Domain knowledge is key to creating effective interaction features. Think about what combinations of features make sense in your problem domain. Well-crafted interaction features can dramatically improve model performance by encoding relationships that the model would otherwise need to learn from scratch.
